name: dire_maul_north
notes: DRAFT: the packs are the world export of map 429 (tools/dungeongen/testdata/map429) grouped by creature_groups (aggro together) and by a 10 yd stand radius, then ordered along the navmesh route; the boss order follows the two locked doors: Mol'dar (courtyard) -> great hall + Fengus -> Gordok Courtyard Door -> Slip'kik (north-west lower ring) -> Gordok Inner Door -> Kromcrush tier -> King Gordok. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
A wait_for on a door a lever or key opens needs timeout_s 60 (the default): a linked door can open 30 s after the use.

Keys: Gordok Courtyard Key 18266 (Fengus's Chest 179516 at 381.42 259.48 11.44, 100 %; Guard Fengus 14321 drops it at 1.2 %) and Gordok Inner Door Key 18268 (Guard Mol'dar 14326, 100 %). The bots' navmesh walks through the closed doors 177219 (385.21 373.8 -1.16) and 177217 (491.25 518.68 29.46); the commander needs both keys to walk them by hand.

Trash: Gordok Brute 11441, Mage-Lord 11444, Warlock 11448, Reaver 11450 and Captain 11445 (faction 45, elite, all humanoid, npc_flags 1 = gossip, hostile: the tribute event's mobs), Gordok Mastiff 13036 and Carrion Swarmer 13160 (beasts, non-elite). Knot Thimblejack 14338 (faction 35) and Stomper Kreeg 14322 (vendor) are not pulled.

Gordok Spirit 11446 (13 spawns in the King's ring, 1 hp, unit_flags 514 = non-attackable) is left alone: it cannot be attacked, so it is no pull (the generator's 13 spirit pulls are gone). Wandering Eye of Kilrogg 14386 (2 patrols, 452 and 707 yd) is not a pull either: it is a patrol block on the pulls its path crosses, and it summons a Netherwalker 22876 when it fights.

The courtyard's First Pack is pool-of-pools 4294 (one of six variants 4295-4300 live, max_limit 1): always 4 ogres at the four points 293.43 22.68, 290 43.94, 278.29 32.93 and 299.92 40.06 (z -2.46..-3.87), entries Brute/Mage-Lord plus a mastiff in variants 2 and 5. The pull lists 11441, 11444 and 13036 at those four points, so whichever variant is live is pulled.

No fleers in the wing: no EventAI flee (command 47) on any entry. Gordok Brute enrages under 30 % (15716, Backhand), the guards enrage at 50 % (8269) and call for help 50 yd, Captain Kromcrush summons two Gordok Reavers 11450 at 50 % (22860), the Warlock casts Summon Doomguard 22865, and the Mage-Lord polymorphs (13323).

The guards' gossip (Mol'dar's Moxie 22818, Fengus' Ferocity 22817, Slip'kik's Savvy 22820) is a buff a player can take before the pull; the bots do not gossip. Guard Fengus and Guard Slip'kik patrol (852 and 465 yd loops): their boss steps stand at their spawn points and the run leader waits/searches for them.

Two packs stand inside a boss's 20 yd detection: leg 1 pull group 8 (4 units at 405-409 329-339, 19.5 yd from Fengus) and leg 2 pull group 9 (2 Warlocks at 577-585 545-549, 18.2 yd from Slip'kik). Either boss joins those fights; he is then dead for his own boss step (the driver notes 'already dead').
Nothing expressible in the rows: entrance/teleports/portal, level_band, hire_composition, cc_priority, no_cc, patrols, the patrolling bosses, the pool variant.
One of three wings of map 429.
